title: the front runs many small commands itself
what: 1) rules/delegation.md and the front skill: the front batches what it must run itself into one call (one command per step, not one per probe), and hands any sequence of 3+ probing commands to a scout or runner; the take-master + record + gate + check sequence goes into the workflow script, not the front. 2) relay report: show front requests per owner turn and front tool calls per turn, with a target, beside the existing F8 line; flag a session above it.
why: Owner, 24 Oct: "a, запиши правило в очередь" (keep the front on Opus effort high; save on the number of front requests instead). Measured on session 0cc68fe0: 952 front requests, each re-reading ~170k tokens of context; context reads 60% of the front's cost, writes 19%, output incl. thinking 21%. The front's notional cost that day was $62 against $58 for all agents. Many requests were small greps, seds, merges and record commands run one by one. rules/delegation.md already says the front only routes, but nothing measures it, so it drifts. Repeats every session (MEDIUM).
failing_case: relay report on session 0cc68fe0 shows no front-requests-per-turn figure and no flag, though the front made ~952 requests for ~40 owner turns.
pass_cases: relay report prints front requests per owner turn and flags a session over the target; the rule text names the batching and the 3+ probes hand-off; a session following it shows fewer front requests per turn in relay report --compare.

fact: Measured 28 Oct 2026 over interactive front sessions with 5+ owner turns (scripted excluded), relay's own unit (requests by message id). Session 0cc68fe0: 534 requests over 47 turns, 11.4 per turn (the item's 952 counted transcript lines, not requests). Others, 30 days, n=76: median / 90th percentile and how many exceed 0cc68fe0: requests per turn 9.75 / 25.4 (30 of 76); tool calls per turn 9.75 / 25.9 (42); front's own non-routing calls per turn (Bash/Read/Edit not queue, merge, handover, git status, Agent, Workflow) 5.1 / 15.2 (58, bad session is 3.0, below the median); share of own calls that are not routing 0.69 / 0.91 (66, bad 0.41); tool results over 3000 chars per turn 0.79 / 3.2 (49, bad 0.40); context tokens read per turn 1.7M / 9.9M (33, bad 2.0M). 10-day window, n=21: requests per turn 9.76 / 17.1 (7 above). No measure puts 0cc68fe0 above a typical session, so no target is set: FRONT_REQUESTS_PER_TURN_TARGET stays a placeholder 15 (flags 0cc68fe0 not) until the owner picks.
